tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground: the warm cream (light) or charcoal (dark). Never tinted per colorway.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, windows, inputs and menus, always outlined in `line`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells, tracks (progress ring, slider) and disabled fills.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text, outlines and icons, on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-sunken`, `accent` and `accent-soft`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, metadata, on `bg` and `surface`.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels only. Deliberately below 4.5:1 (WCAG exempts disabled controls); never use for real content.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Every control and panel outline, 2px (`stroke-2`). An alias of `ink`, so outlines flip with the theme.

tokens.name: line-subtle
tokens.usage: Dashed section dividers and decorative rules. Not for control borders.

tokens.name: shade
tokens.usage: The ink of dither shading: panel shadows and texture. Never text. Ink in light themes; a mid grey in dark so the dither stays visible on charcoal.

tokens.name: shade-accent
tokens.usage: The ink of hover dithers (ghost buttons, tabs, chips) over `surface`. `accent` in light themes, `accent-soft` in dark so `ink` labels stay readable.

tokens.name: sheen
tokens.usage: The glint highlight: the sheen band that sweeps a surface and the light sparkle on pastel fills. Never text.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: THE colorway pastel, = oklch(0.82 0.09 hue). Fills only: primary buttons, selected chips and tabs, progress arcs, the checker. Never text or thin icons on `bg`/`surface`.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet colorway tint: hover wash, selected rows, the soft chip, alert body behind info.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: The colorway's text-capable shade: links, active tab label on `surface`, accent icons, the focus ring. On `bg`, `surface` and `accent-soft`.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `accent` fill, in every theme: pastels always take dark ink.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a solid 3px ring, 2px outside the outline. Alias of `accent-strong` (≥3:1 on every surface).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions; as text on `bg`, `surface` and `danger-soft`. Always paired with the warning icon and a word.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of error alerts and invalid inputs.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Saved, synced, goal met; as text on `bg` and `surface`. A blue-teal, kept off the red-green axis so it never relies on hue against `danger`.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning triangle and caution fills. Fill only, with an `on-accent` glyph (dark in every theme) and `line` outline; never text.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Marketing heroes, onboarding and the box. Pixelify Sans, uppercase, one per view.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section titles on the site and app empty states.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Card and screen titles in the app.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Resting heart rate is steady this week.
styles.usage: Dense UI, card bodies, helper text.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: The one glanceable number on a screen (steps, score). Tabular figures.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, chips, window title bars. Uppercase.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, chip inner gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and inline controls; title-bar padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and window padding; gap between form rows.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards; checker cell on small surfaces.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section spacing in the app; page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section spacing on the landing page.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Tabs and anything that butts against a neighbour.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, windows, cards: the default corner.

tokens.name: radius-2
tokens.usage: Large surfaces: sheets, the app icon mask inset, box mockups.

tokens.name: radius-3
tokens.usage: Marketing tiles and photo frames only.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, toggles, the slider thumb track.

shadow.note: Hard offset, no blur, always down-right: light comes from the top-left. Solid on small controls; panels (cards, windows, alerts, stat tiles) get the same offset as a 50% dither in `shade` instead (see Shading).

tokens.name: elev-1
tokens.usage: Chips at rest, pressed buttons' neighbours, small toggles.

tokens.name: elev-2
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, cards and windows at rest.

tokens.name: elev-3
tokens.usage: Hovered buttons and open menus. Panels use this offset as a dithered shadow.

stroke.note: Outline weights. Everything interactive is outlined.

tokens.name: stroke-1
tokens.usage: Dashed dividers (`line-subtle`) and pixel icons at 16px.

tokens.name: stroke-2
tokens.usage: The default outline for controls, cards, windows and icons.

tokens.name: stroke-3
tokens.usage: Focus ring width; the progress ring's outer edge.

dither.note: Checker shading. One cell size everywhere on screen; densities are 25, 50 and 75% coverage of a 2px checker.

tokens.name: dither-cell
tokens.usage: One dither pixel. The repeat is two cells (4px). Use 3px on marketing pages where it should read as texture from a distance.

tokens.name: dither-tile
tokens.usage: background-size for the .gl-shade-25/50/75 utilities.

motion.note: Things press, lift and dissolve. Movement runs along the shadow axis (down-right to sink, up-left to lift); appearing and disappearing steps through the checker (25, 50, 75, 100%) instead of fading opacity. Pixel-art motion runs at 12fps.

tokens.name: dur-press
tokens.usage: Button press and release: translate into the shadow.

tokens.name: dur-quick
tokens.usage: Hover, toggles, checkbox ticks, chip select, closing anything.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Opening menus, windows and sheets; dither dissolves; tab content swaps.

tokens.name: dur-slow
tokens.usage: Progress ring and slider value changes; screen transitions in the app.

tokens.name: dur-sheen
tokens.usage: The sheen band crossing a surface.

tokens.name: dur-glint
tokens.usage: One full sparkle: 200ms pop, 180ms hold, 520ms collapse.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Everything that enters or moves into place.

tokens.name: ease-in
tokens.usage: Everything that leaves. Leaving is always faster than arriving.

tokens.name: ease-pop
tokens.usage: Overshoot, reserved for earned moments: the sparkle and a newly selected chip. Never on data.

tokens.name: ease-step
tokens.usage: Pixel motion: checker wipes and dither dissolves move in visible frames.

tokens.name: frame-pixel
tokens.usage: One frame at 12fps, the frame rate of pixel-art animation (the pixel sparkle).
